title: The coefficient change of a composite
statement:
For morphisms $a\colon\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ and $b\colon\Lambda'\to\Lambda''$ of condensed
abelian groups (in particular of condensed rings) and every scheme $X$, the coefficient changes
of [def-sfb-coefficient-map] satisfy $(b\circ a)_X=b_X\circ a_X$.
Here, for an arbitrary morphism $c$ of condensed abelian groups, $c_X:=p_X^*c$, with $p_X^*$ the functor of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]; for condensed rings this is exactly [def-sfb-coefficient-map].

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: instantiate the functor law at F = p_X^* and the composable arrows a, b, unfolding c_X := F.map c. Lines 40-49 define Functor and its map_comp field; line 49 gives F.map (a ≫ b) = F.map a ≫ F.map b, which is the stated equation in diagrammatic composition order. The assertion is in the category of abelian sheaves, also when a and b underlie ring morphisms.
